title: Book Title Goes Here
author: Author Name
summary: One or two sentences describing what this test covers. Shown on the title card before the reader begins.

questions.q: Question text. Keep it answerable only by someone who read the book.
questions.why: Optional. Shown in the review screen after a missed question.

_notes.id: Lowercase, no spaces. Must be unique in the catalogue. Leave it out and it will be generated from the title.
_notes.ar.points: Maximum points the title is worth. This is the number the award is calculated from.
_notes.ar.interest: LG (lower grades), MG (middle grades), MG+, UG (upper grades). Free text; displayed as-is.
_notes.quiz.ask: How many questions to draw per attempt. 0 means ask all of them.
_notes.quiz.award: 'proportional' = points x percent scored. 'full' = full points for any passing score. 'none' = track the score only, award nothing.
_notes.quiz.lockRetakes: true = a second attempt needs the instructor password.
_notes.questions[].answer: Zero-based index into the options array. The first option is 0.
_notes.verdicts: Optional flavour lines shown on the results card. 'high' is used at 90% or above. Leave blank to use the system wording.
_notes.questions[].tag: Free text. Used to group the results breakdown, e.g. plot, character, setting, vocabulary, theme.
